subject: general
question:
In the following question, select the missing number of the given series.

1, 5, 21, 85, 341, ?
solution:
**Logic : **

 
• Square of a number series are added subsequently.
 
• The number series starts with (2) and each next number is multiplied by (2).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0e33019209ce660330f8ec2628f6cdead1dc826656cdd745b293330c0fa5857.png] 

Hence, **"1365"** is the correct answer.
